subject: Qualification
notes: kb/Work PB1280 (wave 1011 B2). cite.py --check 8.4.2.2.1 'REDEFINES' OK 2). Data-name-2 of a REDEFINES is unique 'within the context of a REDEFINES clause' because of its required placement (13.18.44.3 NOTE 1; SR7 'the entry that originally defined the area'): ResolveRedefines now names the nearest same-named preceding entry that is NOT itself a redefinition (and, at top level, of the subject's own section: SR10), so `05 N / 05 N REDEFINES N / 05 M REDEFINES N` binds M to the first N instead of misreporting SR7 (COBOL1656). Only when every candidate is a redefinition is the nearest one named, which is SR7's real violation.
